page.content:
Master Builder who pulls Emmet into the fight against Lord Business.

How Wyldstyle connects

  • Work: The LEGO Movie — Wyldstyle is the Master Builder who pulls Emmet into The LEGO Movie.
  • Character: Emmet Brickowski — Wyldstyle trains Emmet to build without instructions.

What is Wyldstyle?

Wyldstyle — Lucy — is the dyed-hair Master Builder who knows the hidden worlds beyond Bricksburg and teaches Emmet that the System can be rebuilt, not only followed.

Key threads lead to The LEGO Movie and Emmet Brickowski.
